candidate_policy: Person tails, exclude head; exhaustive seven tails per head
negative_policy: complete rows for train heads only: tails not among train positives are negative; no heldout truth lookup
message_policy: support at and at_inv only, fixed across all stages; no next or next_inv, including train targets
selection: earliest minimum validation BCE over complete val query rows; all checkpoints selected before test access
encoder: fixed one-layer relation mean, identity activation; train decoder only
sampling_warning: one constructed transductive KG; correlated queries and seed initialization groups are not iid graphs
